video_title: Cavs Practice | Donovan Mitchell Media Availability | 10.07.2026

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the intensity of Cavaliers training camp
quotes.excerpt: Just the level of intensity. On those trips, it can easily get distracted, travel, you're in Spain.
quotes.quote: I would say the second or third practice, just the level of intensity. On those trips, it can easily get distracted, travel, you're in Spain, family, it doesn't feel like training camp. For us to have, I think it was our third or fourth day of camp, it was really intense on both ends of the floor, every drill was intentional, and honestly, that to me really stood out. That showed me mentally where we were all at, because you can really get swayed by the change of place and being in a different country.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell says the intensity at Cavaliers training camp in Spain stood out to him early on. He noted that despite the distractions of being in a different country, the team remained focused and intentional in every drill.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the leadership and experience added to the roster
quotes.excerpt: I think there's a leadership component of it. I think there's an experience component of it.
quotes.quote: I think there's a leadership component of it. I think there's an experience component of it. He's brought his other training camps and what other things he's done on other teams that obviously made it as far as they have here. Obviously, as much as he's learning, we're also learning too, because he's able to teach. He's also able to share his input with the team, him and I in one-on-one situations, him and JB, and then him and Kenny. I think that's the biggest thing, being able to give your input early on, implement it, figure out what's right and wrong about it, watch it on film, see some stuff tomorrow, see some stuff on Sunday, and then the days up to that, kind of go through it.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell highlights the leadership and experience being brought to the Cavaliers roster. He says the team is learning from new additions who are able to teach and share input during practice and film sessions.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the championship-level impact of James
quotes.excerpt: I just truly believe the only reason why he's not talked about in every room is because of championship conversation.
quotes.quote: I just truly believe the only reason why he's not talked about in every room is because of championship conversation. But I've always known it being around him, but when you're his teammate, I think it grew to a whole different level. Seeing him in camp, seeing his influence on the group, seeing his conversation, seeing his passion behind winning, and passion behind intention and trying to be the best of what he does, really puts in perspective how BS a lot of narratives are, and how you really don't truly understand something until you see it from the other side.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell says that being teammates with James has changed his perspective on his impact. Mitchell believes narratives about him are BS and that you do not truly understand his influence until you see it from the other side.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the professional growth and maturity of his teammates
quotes.excerpt: There's stages. I felt like early on in my career I'd get anxious if I didn't feel like I was doing well.
quotes.quote: There's stages. I felt like early on in my career I'd get anxious if I didn't feel like I was doing well. If I go on Instagram and see a pick-up run and be like, 'Damn, I wasn't there.' It's that notion of not feeling like you're doing enough, but more so being, he's very secure in understanding, 'All right, cool. July I'm doing this, August I'm doing this, September I'm doing this. If I don't feel I got enough from practice, I'm doing this.' Some of that stuff I knew, but I think what that does for our group, especially when you have a lot of younger guys too, guys have seen me work, but now you're seeing him as well do it at a high level at his age.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell discusses the maturity of his teammates and the importance of being secure in one's own development process. He notes that younger players are seeing veterans work at a high level and are learning from that example.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the Cavaliers' defensive potential this season
quotes.excerpt: I think we could be a top-five defense.
quotes.quote: I think we could be a top-five defense. I believe that at our, when I first got here, our first two years we were a top-ten, wasn't it? Something like that. I think there's people we've added, like Payton. I think a full year of camp and kind of trying not to give too much, but things we've added, things we've done, I think it kind of helped with that as well. Last year we changed some things, and then also adding James, we were trying to change stuff on the fly. I think this year coming in, I'm really excited about what we can do as far as protecting our paint, protecting ourselves, protecting each other out there on the floor. I think we'll do a better job, that's for sure.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell believes the Cavaliers can be a top five defense this season. He points to roster additions and a full training camp as key factors in the team's renewed focus on protecting the paint and each other.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the Cavaliers' offensive identity and defensive focus
quotes.excerpt: I think first and foremost, we can score with the best of them.
quotes.quote: I think first and foremost, we can score with the best of them. I think that's pretty easy and obvious. But I think for us, not having that be our calling card, because there'll be days where the ball's not going in the rim, right? So understanding that, I think having our defensive in that identity, kind of speaking to our clips as, you know, being that top-five, top-ten defense, top-five, excuse me, being that top-five defense, having that hanging our hat on that. And understanding that, yeah, we're making, we have new guys, we're making changes and different things, but kind of going back to what we were, right? And understanding that, like, that's our intention. We're going to do things intentionally on that end of the floor, and I'm trying to really speak and not really give you all anything unless you really see it.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell says the Cavaliers want to move away from relying solely on offense. He emphasizes that the team is making a conscious effort to make their defensive identity their calling card this season.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the impact of Omar Cook joining the coaching staff
quotes.excerpt: I've known him my whole life, or of him. He's a legend in Omar Cook, I should say.
quotes.quote: I've known him my whole life, or of him. He's a legend in Omar Cook, I should say, not to make him seem old, but growing up in New York, you know who Omar Cook is, right? To be able to have him on staff, it's a huge blessing and honor for me, being from New York, what he's done for basketball, what he's done overseas. And to have that moment, I was pissed I wasn't there because I was just like, 'Man, that's something that really dope to see.' And for him, he was just telling me, 'Man, I lived here, none of this was here.' So for him to kind of get that experience too, I think is pretty sweet.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell calls having New York basketball legend Omar Cook on the Cavaliers coaching staff a huge blessing and honor. He says it is dope to see Cook get the experience of being part of the organization.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Mitchell
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Mitchell on the mentorship of younger players by Omar Cook
quotes.excerpt: A lot of it is being able for him to drop the knowledge of, he's been in the pick-and-roll defensively.
quotes.quote: A lot of it is being able for him to drop the knowledge of, he's been in the pick-and-roll defensively. Obviously, he's a downhill guard. I joke with him that typical New York City guard can't shoot, but he can definitely get downhill, can definitely score. But no, he's a guy that I, we all truly respect. I think a lot of the young guys gravitate towards him because they see themselves in him, and I think for him to consistently give those guys knowledge and really help, it really helps them, you know what I mean, coming into practice, throughout games, and kind of be able to pick what he sees. Him and, you know, Dewayne, obviously guys who have played, for playing, I think is obviously big.
quotes.social_post: Donovan Mitchell says the younger Cavaliers players are gravitating toward assistant coach Omar Cook. He notes that Cook is able to drop knowledge and help players see the game differently through his experience as a former guard.
